definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that is morally upright, socially acceptable, and following the right path. Often used to describe a way of living or earning a livelihood.

examples.japanese: {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な{仕事|しごと}をしなさい。
{彼|かれ}は{真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な{生|い}き{方|かた}をしている。
examples.english: He is living an honest life.

examples.japanese: {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}に{働|はたら}いて{稼|かせ}いだお{金|かね}で{家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}いたい。
examples.english: I want to support my family with money earned through honest work.

notes:
USAGE:
{真|まっ}っ{当|とう} describes something that is morally sound, legitimate, or respectable. It is commonly used when contrasting honest behavior with dishonest or shady alternatives.

FORMS:
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な + noun (a proper ~)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}に + verb (properly, honestly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な{仕事|しごと} (a proper/legitimate job)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な{生活|せいかつ} (a respectable life)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}に{生|い}きる (to live honestly)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}に{稼|かせ}ぐ (to earn a living honestly)
